tagline: A natural-sounding voice for every app on your computer — offline, no key, no cloud.
description:
This is a voice other apps can use. Install it, keep it in your Providers folder, and assign it to Text → speech in Settings → AI models. From then on, every app that asks GifOS to speak — Reader, games, anything that talks — is answered by this app, entirely on your device.

The voice is KittenTTS Nano (Apache-2.0), a small natural-sounding model with eight voices: Bella, Jasper, Luna, Bruno, Rosie, Hugo, Kiki and Leo. It also answers to the familiar names apps already use (nova, shimmer, fable, echo, onyx, alloy), so anything written for a cloud voice works unchanged.

WHAT IT COSTS, PLAINLY. The engine rides inside the app, but the 24 MB voice is downloaded once, checked against a fingerprint baked into the app, and kept on your device. Because it is a natural-sounding model rather than a robotic one, it also has to think before it speaks: it generates a passage of audio before that passage can start playing, so there is a pause at the beginning of each one. How long depends on your device — a laptop and an old phone are not the same machine — and on how much text is asked for at a time.

Once the voice is on your device it never asks the network again. The app itself cannot reach the network, so nothing you ask it to say can leave this device.
author: GifOS
